description: Work out what score is needed on the remaining Canvas work in one course to reach a target percent. Pass course_id as the Canvas course ID or as the course name and target_percent as a number from 0 to 100. If Canvas reports a current percent for that course, pass current_percent to use it instead of computing from graded points alone. Example: "What do I need on the rest of my work in Networking 1 to get an 85 percent?"

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, the number Canvas shows for the course, or the course name such as "Networking 1". Ask get_my_courses for the list of IDs and names.

current_percent.description: Optional, use the percent Canvas reports for the course instead of computing from graded points.

name: get_target_grade
title: Target grade
